title: Two orthonormal frames of the same 2-plane: equal spans and 2-covectors agree up to a sign
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = 2 (Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2), a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and τ = (τ_0, τ_1) an orthonormal pair in ℝ^P (τ : Fin 2 → Euclid P) with a, e ∈ span{τ_0, τ_1}. Then span{τ_0, τ_1} = Q, and there is ε ∈ ℤ with |ε| = 1 (ε.natAbs = 1) such that α(τ) = ε·α(a, e) for every 2-covector α ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, 2), where α(a, e) denotes α applied to ![a, e].
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (τ : Fin 2 → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → Orthonormal ℝ τ → a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) → e ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q ∧ ∃ ε : ℤ, ε.natAbs = 1 ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) 2, α τ = (ε : ℝ) * α ![a, e]
